Generate paired validation summaries, seed confidence intervals, wins, and explicit multiple-comparison scope
Verify all nongate checkpoint tensors exactly equal their frozen uniform base
Verify original Shapley/deployment formula AST equality and full-forward reproduction of saved validation scores
Compute label-informed modality-dominance subgroup diagnostics without using them for model selection
Save ALL_FINISHED or FAILED_REQUIRES_REVIEW status and complete logs
resume_instruction: Read the remote STATUS.json and finalizer.log first. If finished, download the three summaries and checkpoint_audit.json, report all positive and negative results, distinguish validation from test and representation gain from gate gain.
